claims.claim: Israeli VAT is 18% (since 1 January 2025). Delivery menu price formula: Menu Price = target net revenue / (1 - commission rate), then x1.18 for VAT. Packaging/delivery cost typically 3-8 NIS per order. Prices are in NIS, rounded to whole shekels on delivery platforms.
claims.raw_snippet: Israel's standard VAT rate is 18% effective 1 January 2025.

claims.claim: Food-safety temperature guidance follows the HACCP danger zone: cold storage below 4 C, hot holding above 60 C, received cold goods below 4 C. Kosher certification levels are distinct: כשר (regular kosher), כשר למהדרין (mehadrin / strictly kosher), כשר לפסח (kosher for Passover). Mislabeling carries trust and legal risk.
claims.raw_snippet: Cold storage below 4C and hot holding above 60C (HACCP danger zone 4-60C). Kosher levels כשר / כשר למהדרין / כשר לפסח are distinct certifications.
